option_relations.rationale: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a distinct condition and not directly related to severe sepsis in the provided leaves.
Infectious Mononucleosis (EBV-associated HLH) is a specific type of HLH and not directly related to severe sepsis in the provided leaves.
Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma (SPTCL) with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a specific lymphoma with HLH, and not directly related to severe sepsis in the provided leaves.
Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, is a type of lymphoma and not directly related to severe sepsis in the provided leaves.
